applicationId.description: Local identifier of the application (not its virtual blockchain identifier). The application must be published online before calling this endpoint. When omitted, an application must be associated with the API key.

virtualBlockchainId.description: Identifier of the target application ledger. If omitted, a new virtual blockchain is created for this anchor request

chainStorageInDays.description: Retention period in days for the anchored data on the Carmentis blockchain. After this period, data may be archived or removed. Required only for the first microblock of the virtual blockchain.

gasPriceInAtomics.description: Gas price in atomic units to use for the anchoring transaction. If limits are defined in the API key, then the gas price must be within theses limits (gasMinAtomics - gasMaxAtomics)

channels.description: List of channels to create in this virtual blockchain. Each channel controls data visibility to different actors

name.title: Name of the channel
name.description: Unique identifier for this channel within the virtual blockchain

public.title: Channel visibility
public.description: Indicates whether the channel is public (visible to all) or private (visible only to authorized actors)

actors.title: List of actors to create
actors.description: All participants/actors that need to be created and used in this transaction

name.title: Name of the actor
name.description: Identifier for this actor within the virtual blockchain. Used in authorizations and endorsements

data.title: Data being anchored on chain
data.description: Your business-related data to be anchored. This is the actual payload being recorded on the blockchain

channelAssignations.description: Assignment of data fields to specific channels. Controls which actors can see which data

channelName.description: The name of the channel to assign the fields.

actorAssignations.description: Assignment of channel visibility to specific actors

channelName.description: The name of the channel visible by the actor.

hashableFields.description: Fields whose values should be hashed for zero-knowledge proofs

fieldPath.description: States that data indicated by this field is hashable.

maskableFields.description: Fields that support masking (redaction) of specific parts. Useful for PII and sensitive data

fieldPath.description: States that data indicated by this field is maskable.

position.description: Position of the masked part in the field.

length.description: Length of the masked part in the field.

author.title: Author
author.description: The actor who initiated this transaction. Usually your application server or user identity
